contract.result: (x0 + sum(rhs[0..N))) mod p, final canonical FE64 and 32 BE bytes; N counts RHS; x0 once; no observable prefixes
contract.scope: field final-only vector sum; eight FE64-input routes; no production integration or CT/upper-layer gain
contract.native: API eager, inline eager, four u128-column deferred schedules (chunk16/4094 and banks1/4); no representation conversion
contract.fe52: unchanged P3 E2E Full16/Full4094; FE64 packing at use inside timed sum; no resident FE52 array
contract.allocation: one FE64 RHS array; allocation and generation excluded; all routes include seed handling and final bytes
contract.timing: whole noinline/noipa jobs include kernel, call, seed reset, RHS loads/packing, reduction, loops and serialization; no per-RHS barriers
contract.verification: all48cells validated raw canonical and full bytes versus actual FE64 before timing; last identical job per region checked after timing; Boost oracle is separate
contract.input_preservation: exact regeneration compares x0 and all raw FE64 words after untimed validation and after regions; all32bytes enter FNV hash
contract.calibration: one job initially; two consecutive regions >=floor at the SAME count; retain shorts; grow ceil(1.5*target*jobs/elapsed), capped; no warmup if unqualified
contract.region_duration: every warmup/measured region has one continuous clock; append calibrated-size job batches (last may be capped) until floor; never restart/discard a short prefix
contract.probes: fixed stack storage, no per-extension allocation; cumulative timestamp/job stores, clock checks and continuation work are timed; JSON and probe conversion outside clock
contract.duration_failure: explicit non-success status if later-phase floor cannot be reached within caps; preserve record, cumulative probes, actual jobs and last full output
contract.normalization_unit: elapsed/actual total jobs for ns/sum; elapsed/(actual jobs*N) for ns/RHS; not initial calibrated jobs after an extension
contract.ordering: seeded six-size/eight-route permutations plus round rotation/reversal; second series reverses each complete order, not corpus
contract.statistics: all raw attempts retained; summaries/ratios use verified duration-qualified measurement records only; any failed later record prevents complete status
contract.ratio_direction: numerator A / denominator B, same size and measurement round; >1 favors B; job counts can differ
contract.cpu: one thread deliberately measures carry/ILP scheduling; external pinning; endpoint snapshots do not prove no migration or constant clock; no policy changes
contract.backend: external manifest binds kernel/driver/library/binary hashes and no-LTO commands; harness macros are not proof of library configuration

corpus.hash_recipe: FNV1a64 unsigned wrap; x0 BE32 followed by every RHS BE32; same x0 initializes each prefix hash
